title: Baby Trend Recalls Tango Mini Strollers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Both of the stroller's hinge joints can release and collapse under pressure, posing a fall hazard to children in the stroller. Units: About 2,000.

title: The Thompson's Company Recalls Aerosol Waterproofing Wood and Masonry Protectors Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The contents of the cans can react with the package, causing rust to form along the can seam, which could spread to other areas of the can and create pinhole leaks. title: Boston Warehouse Trading Corp. Recalls Holiday Travel Mugs Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Meijer Stores
summary: The mugs are mislabeled as microwave safe. If microwaved, the metallic print on the mug can spark, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,400.

title: Libbey Glass Recalls Milk Bottles Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The bottles can break unexpectedly during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 44,300.

title: Thesaurus Global Marketing Recalls Tricycles Due to Violation of the Federal Lead Paint Ban; Risk of Poisoning; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: Paint on the canopy's frame contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban and tricycle components contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 370.

title: Bobcat Company Recalls Utility Vehicles (UTVs) Due to Collision and Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The rear brake line can become punctured causing the brakes to fail, posing a collision and crash hazard. Units: About 522 (In addition, 53 were sold in Canada).

title: K-Apparel Recalls Children’s Lounge Pants Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The children's lounge pants fail to meet the flammability standard for children's sleepwear that requires sleepwear to be either snug-fitting or flame resistant, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 2,200.

title: Pier 1 Recalls Desk Chairs Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The chair's legs can break, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 6,000 (In addition, about 300 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls Brutus Utility Vehicles (UTVs) Due to Collision and Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The rear brake line can become punctured causing the brakes to fail, posing a collision and crash hazard. Units: About 340 (In addition, 19 units were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls Pro XD Utility Vehicles Due to Collision and Crash Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The rear brake line can become punctured causing the rear brakes to fail, posing a collision and crash hazard to the rider. Units: About 760.

title: Delta Enterprise Corp. Recalls Incline Sleeper with Adjustable Feeding Position for Newborns to Prevent Risk of Suffocation
summary: Infant fatalities have been reported with other manufacturers' inclined sleep products, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side, or under other circumstances. Units: About 5,900.

title: Evenflo Recalls Pillo Portable Napper Inclined Sleepers to Prevent Risk of Suffocation
summary: Infant fatalities have been reported with other manufacturers' inclined sleep products, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side, or under other circumstances. Units: About 3,100.

title: Graco Recalls Little Lounger Rocking Seats to Prevent Risk of Suffocation
summary: Infant fatalities have been reported with other manufacturers' inclined sleep products, after infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side, or under other circumstances. Units: About 111,000 units have been sold in the United States and about 1,800 in Mexico.

title: Summer Infant Recalls SwaddleMe By Your Bed Inclined Sleepers to Prevent Risk of Suffocation
summary: Infant fatalities have been reported with other manufacturers' inclined sleep products, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side, or under other circumstances. Units: About 46,300.

title: PCNA Recalls Power Banks Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The power bank's lithium-ion battery can overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 5,000 (about 445 were sold in Canada).

title: STIHL Recalls Pressure Washers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The pressure washer nozzle can disconnect from the spray wand when under pressure during use, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 16,400.

title: Varidesk Recalls Stand2Learn Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The foot support on the stool was improperly welded and can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,700 (In addition, about 300 units were sold in Canada).
